answer: Stake first, then work. Three jurors drawn from separate pools score the same submission; when their scores diverge past a threshold, the protocol slashes the claimant's bond instead of paying it. Compare that to a name-list design where a wharf of aliases costs nothing. Here every identity must renew with fresh attestation each epoch or the record expires, and the basalt floor of the bond stays locked, so a falcon that never hunts still pays for the perch.
